_note: Hotels.com property urls for the hotels in our best-read guides, found by hand. THERE IS NO PRODUCT FEED - Hotels.com's entire CJ inventory is 24 campaign links and not one is a property (see scripts/cj-product-feed.mjs), so this cannot be automated and every entry here was looked up.
_storefront: Normalised to uk.hotels.com. The ho<id> is the same on every storefront; only the domain and currency differ, and a British audience should not land on the US site.
_slugs: The slug is HISTORICAL and frequently carries a hotel's former name - Aethos is filed as nobu-hotel-shoreditch, One Hundred as ace-hotel-london-shoreditch. The id identifies the property; never match on the slug.
_needsCheck: Entries with needsCheck have two candidate listings or a rebrand and must be opened before the url goes on the sheet. A link that works but lands on the wrong or stale listing is the failure mode this file exists to prevent.
